message.content: {"action": "create", "target_skill_ids": [], "reason": "候选技能描述的是下载器中间件 process_exception 钩子的异常分派能力，与现有技能（hostname 判定、允许域名正则构建）在 task_family、method_family、stage 上均不同，属于新的独立微技能；peer_candidates 中的 process_response/process_request 技能虽同属 hook_return_dispatch，但 stage 与钩子不同，不构成 split 或 merge 关系。", "resolved_skill": {"skill_id": "8229ccc7-e91d-5a88-8085-5887e69febd6", "name": "下载器中间件 process_exception 异常处理分派", "description": "在下载器中间件的 process_exception 钩子中，按返回值类型分派下载处理器或 process_request 抛出的异常：返回 None 继续传递异常，返回 Response 启动 process_response 链，返回 Request 重新调度。用于实现异常恢复、重试或降级中间件。", "asset_type": "micro_skill", "granularity": "micro", "asset_node_id": "micro_skill_node", "asset_level": 3, "objective": "按返回值类型正确分派 process_exception 的异常处理", "domain": "scrapy", "task_family": "downloader_middleware", "method_family": "hook_return_dispatch", "stage": "exception_handling", "workflow_steps": ["确认异常来源为下载处理器或 process_request 抛出（含 IgnoreRequest）", "根据期望行为选择返回值：None 继续传递、Response 恢复并进入 process_response 链、Request 重新调度", "返回所选对象并验证异常处理链行为符合预期"], "intervention_moves": ["返回 None 以继续传递异常并执行其他中间件的 process_exception", "返回 Response 以启动 process_response 链并跳过其他 process_exception", "返回 Request 以重新调度请求"], "constraints": ["process_exception 只能返回 None、Response 对象或 Request 对象", "返回 Response 时不再调用其他中间件的 process_exception"], "cautions": ["返回 None 时异常会继续传递直至默认异常处理", "返回 Response 会跳过其余 process_exception 方法"], "support_summary": {"support_count": 1, "conflict_count": 0, "support_sections": ["Downloader Middleware"], "evidence_snippets": ["SUPPORT | Downloader Middleware: `process_response()` should either: return a [`Response`](request-response.html#scrapy.http.Response) object, return a [`Request`](request-response.html#scrapy.http.Request) object o..."]}}}
